title: Citizens Financial Closes Clarfeld Financial Advisors Buyout
主要内容: Citizens Financial Group, Inc. completed the acquisition of Clarfeld Financial Advisors, integrating the latter into its Wealth Management division. Clarfeld will retain its brand name and operate as a unit of Citizens Bank Wealth Management. Robert A. Clarfeld will serve as CEO of Citizens' high net worth and ultra-high net worth businesses. As of September 30, 2018, Clarfeld managed $6.6 billion in assets and administered $900 million. The combined entity will have approximately $14.4 billion in AUM and $34.1 billion in AUM/AUA. This acquisition reflects the company's strategy to strengthen its capital position and diversify revenue streams. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Citizens Financial Group, Inc. (CFG).
